now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
now.text: Buck Cashman supervises Daniel Blake as Blake rises on Fisk's staff. When Blake refuses to give up BB Urich as the leaker, Cashman kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Buck's charge on Fisk's staff. Refuses to give up BB Urich, so Buck kills him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Blake's supervisor on Fisk's staff. Kills Blake for refusing to give up BB Urich.

proposed.text: Buck Cashman oversees Daniel Blake on Fisk's staff. After Blake lets BB Urich escape, Cashman tortures him, and when Blake refuses to say where she is, Cashman kills him.

changes.evidence: In Daredevil: Born Again S2#7 ('The Hateful Darkness') Blake nearly hands BB to Cashman but lets her escape; Cashman tortures Blake, who refuses to give up BB's location, then kills him. BB was already known to them as the leaker (in S2#6 Cashman tells Blake to feed BB false information), so 'refuses to give up BB Urich as the leaker' is wrong.

owner_calls.question: Stage 0 sits on the first episode (Blade: The Series, part 1 of the two-part pilot) but describes Krista spying on Marcus for Blade as his lover. That only becomes possible after Marcus turns her and Blade recruits her (stage 1, #2), so stage 0 is earlier than what it says has happened. How should it be fixed?
options: Move stage 0 after stage 1, to the episode where Krista and Marcus first become lovers (episode not pinned down from sources here)
Rewrite stage 0 as the first-episode setup only (Krista hunts her twin brother's killer, Marcus) with kind enemy, and add a later partner stage
Merge stage 0 into stage 1 and keep stage 2
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia premise: Marcus turns Krista into a vampire, then Blade injects her with his serum and recruits her; the rest of the season follows her keeping her cover in the House of Chthon while her feelings for Marcus grow. The pilot 'House of Chthon' is episodes 1 and 2.

owner_calls.question: Do Howard and Dooley ever meet on screen? Dooley hunts Howard through Agent Carter S1#1-7 and dies in S1#7 wearing Howard's heat vest, but Howard only comes to the SSR in S1#8 (Dooley is only mentioned there). If they never share a scene, does the connection pass N7 under the huge-consequences exception, or should it be dropped?
options: Keep it (Howard's case and vest have huge consequences for Dooley)
Drop the connection (Dooley only knows about Howard)
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki appearance list for Roger Dooley: AC101-AC107 on screen, AC108 mentioned only. His death scene is in the Stark Heat Vest in SNAFU (S1#7).

owner_calls.question: The stage text is true, but it describes two separate actions (Yo-Yo traps Hive and frees the hostages; Talbot's military contacts help stop the launch) with nothing happening between Elena and Talbot. Keep it, or remove it as a stage with no interaction between them?
owner_calls.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#21 'Absolution': Coulson and Fitz, with Talbot's help, stop the warhead launch, while Yo-Yo finishes Mack's memory machine, frees Hive's hostages and traps Hive in the suspension-gel cage. No scene between Yo-Yo and Talbot is described.
